SOUP! It's my day off and I'm feeling lazy. I just finished cooking a big pot full of homemade vegetable soup.

Introducing my home-made, lazy, average guy "no I'm not a chef" vegetable soup!

You will need:

  • Any veg you like. I used cabbage, onions, celery, carrots and broccoli
  • Stock. Again, use any kind of stock you'd like. You can even make it yourself! Just make sure you have enough to cover the vegetables. I usually use the pre-made stuff. Two cartons.
  • Some water, though I only use this because I run out of stock lol. About 500ml
  • Salt to your liking.

All you have to do is roughly chop the veg, add 'em to a pot and cover with stock (and water if needed). Bring it to a boil, then bring it down to a simmer. Cover the pot and let it simmer for 90 mins. After 90 mins is up, taste it and add whatever amount of salt you think it needs!

Really easy. Really cheap. Really filling. And extremely delicious.

Bachelor Chow:

  • Bundle of Spinach

  • Bundle of Kale

  • 2 cans of chickpeas (for protein)

  • 1/2 red onion

  • 1 tomato

  • 1 yellow squash

  • 1 zucchini

Chop everything up and layer into a large bowl. When ready to eat, put 2 tbsp of olive oil into a pan a sauté two handfuls of chow per person. Once veggies are soft and greens are wilted, cover with sauce, or broth, or canned soup. Cook until warm, plate, and eat.

I got this recipe from elsewhere and it's been a pretty good staple for dinner. Takes about and hour of prep (I'm slow when it comes to knife work) and can make 3-5 meals depending on the number of people consuming it. You can swap out or add any veggies really easily, and using different toppings keeps it fresh to your palate.
